## What changes?

Describe the change and its purpose.

## Validation

- [ ] PR checks pass.
- [ ] No credentials, Terraform state, model weights or sensitive prompts are included.
- [ ] A model release uses a new release ID and an exact pipeline version.
- [ ] The candidate manifest has an S3 object version and SHA-256 fingerprint.
- [ ] The reviewer can find the model, license review and candidate evidence.

## Operational effect

State what runs after merge, expected cost, and the recovery procedure.
